evals.description: A peer-review critique must never invent a defect that is not present in the draft under review, nor assert a statistic the draft does not contain.
evals.assert: Every finding the review surfaces cites a concrete line, number, or claim that actually appears in the reviewed draft; no fabricated defects, no invented denominators, no hallucinated code-set mismatches.

evals.description: Surprising results are challenged before they are accepted (Twyman's Law).
